body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Re-verified on claude-review @ e4b58abe:
(1) packages/parallax/lib/modes.mjs runRouteMode returned `equivalent: Boolean(judgeResult.equivalent)` with no schema check, so a judge payload of `{"equivalent":"false","variants":["Postgres","MySQL"]}` (or a refusal object carrying any non-empty `equivalent`) became a pass: `parallax --route "Which db?" --n 2 --questions-json` printed `{"questions":[],"gate":true,...}` and exited 0, while `{}` exited 2 with an empty, unmeasured divergence. The divergence path in the same file already validates its payload with divergencePayloadError.
(2) packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs 'the ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE seam is ignored unless NODE_ENV is test' spawned the bin with the parent environment including provider API keys; with a key exported it made live model calls (observed: `anthropic 401` with a dummy key) and could fail when readings converged. It passed on an unkeyed machine only because provider lookup failed, and it did not assert that reason.
(3) packages/parallax/lib/prompts.mjs spliced model-authored fan readings (buildDivergencePrompt), fan answers (buildRouteJudgePrompt) and ticket titles (buildEdgePrompt, titles are only checked to be non-empty strings) into judge prompts outside any UNTRUSTED fence; the judge verdicts decide pass vs gateFail.
(4) The parallax CLI refuses `--record-verdict` without `--ticket` (exit 1, nothing recorded), but step 1 of plugins/adlc-claude-code/commands/adlc-spec.md, plugins/adlc-cursor/command/adlc-spec.md (plugins/adlc-cursor/commands is a symlink to it) and plugins/adlc-pi/prompts/adlc-spec.md, and three examples in packages/parallax/README.md, spelled `parallax ... --prompt-only --record-verdict <file>` with no `--ticket`, so an agent following the P1 flow verbatim hit exit 1 at the first step.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/parallax`: bin/parallax.mjs (CLI, maps thrown errors from lib to exit 1 via opError), lib/modes.mjs (runDivergenceAnalysis, runRouteMode, divergencePayloadError, fanWidthError, resolveDeps), lib/prompts.mjs (prompt builders, uses core fence()), lib/scoring.mjs, lib/verdict.mjs. Tests: `npm test -w packages/parallax` from the worktree root. The deps seam ({fan, complete}) drives runRouteMode in-process; the NODE_ENV=test-gated ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE seam ({fan, judge}) drives the bin. packages/parallax/test/context-fencing.test.mjs counts UNTRUSTED fences in edge prompts and must be narrowed to body fences once titles are fenced; fan-integrity.test.mjs's seam test must be made hermetic. Doc guard for the harness commands: scripts/test/adlc-spec-parallax-mode.test.mjs (unchanged) plus the new scripts/test/parallax-record-verdict-ticket-docs.test.mjs.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. One exported pure validator `judgePayloadError(result)` in lib/modes.mjs returns null for a well-formed route judge payload, else a message starting `route judge returned an off-schema payload`. Well-formed: a non-array object; `equivalent` is a boolean; when true, `answer` is a non-empty string; when false, `variants` is a non-empty array of strings. runRouteMode throws that message right after extractJson, so the CLI exits 1 in every output mode (text, --json, --questions-json) and never prints `"gate": true` for it. Fail closed: no coercion of `equivalent`.
2. The mock-seam inertness test removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, ADLC_AGY and ADLC_PROVIDER from the child environment and asserts stderr matches `no LLM provider configured`.
3. Each fan reading is fenced as `reading-<n>` (cap 12000, head-biased), each route answer as `answer-<n>` (cap 6000, head-biased), each ticket title as `ticket-<id>-title` (cap 300, head-biased), with the standing UNTRUSTED directive stated in the divergence and route judge prompts. scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs pins the new call sites and forbids the raw splices.
4. Every documented `parallax ... --record-verdict` invocation carries `--ticket <id>`; the three adlc-spec step-1 lines state why. Well-formed judge payloads and all existing exit codes keep their current behaviour.
5. Documentation: update packages/parallax/README.md ("What a verdict requires", exit-code table, untrusted-data paragraph) and make the same verdict/exit-code edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/parallax.mdx (hand-maintained mirror, never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 An off-schema route judge payload (string equivalent, refusal object, {}, [], equivalent:true without answer, equivalent:false without string variants) is refused by judgePayloadError and runRouteMode, and the CLI exits 1 without an empty passing frontier. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/judge-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC2 The mock-seam inertness tests reach provider lookup with no provider configured, even when a key is exported. verify: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-dummy node --test packages/parallax/test/judge-integrity.test.mjs packages/parallax/test/fan-integrity.test.mjs`
- AC3 Readings, answers and ticket titles are fenced with their caps and numbering. verify: `node --test packages/parallax/test/judge-integrity.test.mjs scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`
- AC4 No tracked doc documents `parallax ... --record-verdict` without `--ticket`. verify: `node --test scripts/test/parallax-record-verdict-ticket-docs.test.mjs scripts/test/adlc-spec-parallax-mode.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green (context-fencing.test.mjs narrowed to body fences). verify: `npm test -w packages/parallax`
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "Off-schema route judge payload" packages/parallax/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/parallax.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC7 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: fencing the raw feature request in buildSpecReaderPrompt or the question in route prompts; restricting ticket titles or ids to one line in the ticket schema; the ticket id used inside fence labels; any change to divergence scoring, fan-width rules or --record-verdict semantics.
title: parallax: refuse off-schema route judge payloads, fence judge inputs, and document --ticket with --record-verdict
